name: @liquiddesign/freelo-mcp

tools.name: freelo_download_file
tools.description: Download a file from Freelo using its UUID. Files are found in task comments. Downloads the file to a temporary directory and returns the file path. Get file UUIDs by retrieving task details with freelo_get_task.

fileUuid.description: The UUID of the file to download (found in task comments)

filename.description: Optional filename to save as (otherwise uses UUID)

tools.name: freelo_get_task
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Freelo task by its ID. Returns task name, description, author, assignee, dates, priority, state, project, task list, comments (with files), and all other task details.

taskId.description: The unique ID of the task to retrieve

tools.name: freelo_list_task_subtasks
tools.description: List all subtasks of a specific Freelo task. Returns subtask names, completion status, and order positions.

taskId.description: The unique ID of the task to retrieve subtasks for
